vuln_statements.explanation: This statement iterates over the tag_list while holding tag_list_lock. Based on the vulnerability description about improper handling of tag_list_lock or BLK_MQ_F_TAG_QUEUE_SHARED flag transitions leading to race conditions or use-after-free when queues are added/removed concurrently, this iteration is vulnerable because concurrent queue modifications during this traversal can cause use-after-free or corruption of the list structure. The lock may not properly protect against all concurrent operations on the tag_list.

This statement freezes each queue during the tag_list iteration. Combined with the list_for_each_entry above, improper sequencing or missing synchronization between queue freezing and tag_list modifications can lead to race conditions where queues are freed while still being referenced in the iteration, causing use-after-free vulnerabilities.
